summary: Typed links between intents, and step dependencies that cross intents
riskReason: Validation starts reading other intents' refs, so a missing or broken ref now affects this intent too.

add.signature: (repo, id) => links from other intents that point at this one

change.to: steps of this plan or of another intent in the same repo

rules.text: links are stored on one side only, and reverse links are computed by scanning refs/plans
a link or cross-intent dependency must point at an intent, and step, that exists
the intent gate shows outgoing and incoming links, follow-ups included

evidence: validation rejects a link to an intent that doesn't exist
this repo's #2 shows #1 as linking to it
